Your records stay on this device, in the browser. Nothing is uploaded unless you turn on encrypted sync for an account. Health only syncs after a separate opt-in.

If you do turn on sync, your records are encrypted on the device before they leave it. The server stores the encrypted data and the details needed to deliver it, but it cannot read your plans, habits or health entries. Signing in with an email code does not recover your data; only the recovery secret unlocks it.

Backups are optional too. You can make an encrypted backup with its own secret, export readable files per area, or use Export everything for a readable ZIP.

I am ZIGi, your own AI, connected with your key, a local model or OpenRouter sign-in. ZIGoals runs no AI service and does not see this conversation. Answers here are labelled as coming from your AI.
